'''Emie Nalmar''' was the wife of [[Ral Nalmar]], and the mother of [[Elana Nalmar]]. She was killed during the attack on the [[Nalmar residence|Nalmar mansion]] perpetrated by [[Qual'om Soach]]'s forces.
